Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses This bid is reserved for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs)owned by Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Women Entrepreneurs, in accordance with the applicable Government of India p rocurement policy and the directions issued by the Food Corporation of India (FCI). The reservation is intended to support FCI in achieving its annual procurement targets from MSE SC/ST-o wned enterprises and Women-owned MSEs. Eligibility Conditions: 1. The bidder shall be a valid Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) registered on the Udyam Registration Portal. 2. The bidder shall possess a valid Udyam Registration Certificate indicating MSE status. 3. For claiming reservation under the SC/ST category, the enterprise shall be owned by an SC/ST entrepre neur as per the applicable Government of India guidelines. 4. For claiming reservation under the Women category, the enterprise shall be owned and controlled by a woman entrepreneur in accordance with the applicable Government of India guidelines. 5. The bidder shall upload all supporting documents on the GeM portal to establish eligibility under the clai med category. 6. If a bidder claims the benefit under the reserved category but fails to furnish valid documentary evidenc e, the bid shall be evaluated in accordance with the applicable GeM and Government procurement rules. .
